Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: DPA redlines, SCCs and transfer impact — draft attached

Jordan — thanks for the quick turnaround and the consolidated packet. A few questions that will determine whether we can accept the proposed SCCs and the transfer addendum as-is: 

1) KMS requirement — our security team prefers customer-managed keys for EU PHI workloads. Is that supported in the Private deployment, and what are the cost/sourcing implications?
2) Subprocessor disclosure cadence — we need quarterly notice for any new subprocessor additions (your draft has 30 days). Could you move to 90 days with an exception for critical infra changes?
3) Liability cap carveouts — Finance wants a carveout for data breach remediation costs beyond the standard cap; are you able to accept an exception limited to regulatory fines?
4) Controller/Processor mapping — we like the narrow mapping approach but need an explicit clause that usage telemetry for billing will remain redacted for PHI customers.

We can do the call Wed Apr 14 10:00 EDT if that works for your team — we can bring our security lead. I cc'd Paul (outside counsel) who will track any material legal changes.

—Emma
Procurement, Sage Therapeutics
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: DPA redlines, SCCs and transfer impact — internal strategy

Team — quick legal ops note after reviewing Emma's questions and the client redlines:

1) KMS / PME: We can support customer‑managed keys for Private deployments; need to flag an SOW addendum (implementation + ops SLA) and a one‑time integration fee. Ben, please estimate the onboarding fee and any recurring surcharge for HSM-backed keys.

2) Subprocessor notice: Agree with compromise — offer 90 day notice + immediate notice for critical infra/security patches. Update DPA §3.4 accordingly. Olga, can you draft the exact language consistent with our Subproc policy?

3) Liability carveout: We cannot accept unlimited breach remediation exposure. We can accept a limited carveout for regulatory fines (capped at X *monthly service fee*). Finance/RevOps needs to sign off. Ben, include a line item reference in the order form showing impact if this carveout is accepted.

4) Telemetry redaction: Offer explicit telemetry redaction language limited to PHI workloads; operationally we can provide a redaction promise but need a fallback (audit logs available to Sage under NDA). Karthik — confirm whether telemetry redaction will require code changes or simple config flags.

5) SCCs: We prefer the narrow controller-processor mapping exhibit (keeps exposure low) but retain the standard SCCs as an alternate if Sage insists. Keep both exhibits in the packet and mark the preferred one for execution.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Ben: onboarding fee + order form pricing impact (Apr 13 EOD)
- Olga: subprocessor notice language + telemetry redaction clause (Apr 13 mid-day)
- Karthik: technical note on telemetry redaction feasibility + KMS ops impacts (Apr 13 EOD)
- Jordan: confirm Wed 14 call and push the DocuSign timeline

I'll draft a short email to Emma after we have the pricing note and language updates.

Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: DPA redlines, SCCs and transfer impact — next steps and MAP

Emma — thanks for the points. We reviewed internally and can offer the following compromise: 

- KMS: Customer‑managed keys supported on Private only. We will provide an SOW addendum for HSM integration; Ben will include one‑time onboarding fee and a monthly ops surcharge.
- Subprocessors: We will update DPA to 90 day notice + immediate notice for security-critical updates (language attached).
- Liability: We can accept a narrow regulatory fines carveout (capped at 6x monthly committed spend). We'll surface the pricing impact in the order form.
- Telemetry: We will include a PHI telemetry redaction clause; audit logs available on request under NDA. Karthik confirmed no major code changes required — configuration + logging filter will handle the redaction for your tenant.

Next steps / Mutual Action Plan (MAP):
1) Apr 13 EOD: Redwood to send updated DPA (Laura/Olga) and order form pricing note (Ben).
2) Apr 14 10:00 EDT: 30m call with Sage security + procurement to walk SCCs and KMS SOW (we'll use the proposed SCCs-exhibit-proposed.json as the working doc).
3) Apr 15: Expected counter‑redline/signature window (DocuSign link to be issued once both DPA and Order Form are agreed).

DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abc123 — we will populate after Apr 14 call.

If that timeline works I will circulate the updated packet tomorrow morning. Appreciate the quick turnaround on your end.

Best — Jordan
